name: COLD GAS
tagline: Ten thrusters. One roll. Stick the landing.

capture.notes: Real frames from a Debug build (1.1.0): the reference runs flown live and frozen at a tick with their controls up (-play -autopilot -freeze <tick>), Free Drive cruising 3 km out (-freedrive -fd-km 3 -fd-cruise 25), and the results after a whole run (the judges written on the device by Apple's on-device model). 6.9-inch simulator for raw/iphone, 13-inch iPad for raw/ipad. raw/duo is from 1.0.0 (an open Duo's inner screen). A person picks the frames.

shots.title: Clear the row. *Stick it.*
shots.sub: Ten cold-gas thrusters. One mark to land on.

shots.title: Hang upside down. *Let go.*
shots.sub: Hold to climb, tap to release, hold to land.

shots.title: Three judges. *On your device.*
shots.sub: Apple Intelligence writes their words with no network. A fixed scorer sets every number.

shots.title: Fly *ten valves* by hand.
shots.sub: Assist, Pro, Advanced: take the computer away one tier at a time.

shots.title: Then just *drive.*
shots.sub: Off the apron into a world that goes on. No timer, no score.

shots.title: Feel *every wheel* land.
shots.sub: A synced landing is one clean thump. A sloppy one is four.

shots.title: Over the row, *onto the mark.*
shots.sub: The sink rate turns amber. Brake on the jets before it's red.

shots.title: Roll it *over the line.*
shots.sub: Off the kicker, a barrel roll over five parked cars, wheels down.

shots.title: Open it. *Fly it.*
shots.sub: Edge to edge when open. In tabletop, the screen on top and the controller below.

feature.title: Clear the row. *Stick it.*
